findings.review: Second edit raises the main embrasure and exterior muzzle to continue the interior barrel's upward-right axis. Hollow muzzle rim is visible. Two separate secondary stone-framed openings remain, one in the internal side wall and one above the main firing aperture. Vault, earth covering, pale stone and wood retain the existing concept. True external transparency checked on checkerboard and light/dark backgrounds.
findings.limits: Visual coherence only, not an engineering drawing or exact named-site reconstruction. Fine details and the bore are subordinate at 32 pixels.
